marketing.title: AI search overviews reshape SEO
marketing.summary: Brands are optimising for AI-generated answer boxes on Google and ChatGPT, not just blue links, shifting content strategy toward direct, quotable answers.

marketing.title: Short-form video still wins attention
marketing.summary: Vertical video under 30 seconds continues to outperform other formats for reach, pushing brands to prioritise TikTok and Reels-native production over polished long-form ads.

marketing.title: Creator-led brand campaigns
marketing.summary: Companies are handing creative control to individual creators instead of running top-down campaigns, trading brand consistency for authenticity and trust.

marketing.title: First-party data as the new targeting layer
marketing.summary: With third-party cookies fading, marketers lean harder on owned data (email, loyalty programs, on-site behaviour) to power personalisation and retargeting.

marketing.title: Community over reach
marketing.summary: Smaller, engaged communities on Discord, Substack, and private groups are outperforming broad-reach ad spend for retention and word of mouth.

design.title: Kinetic typography as a default, not a flourish
design.summary: Type that moves, stretches, and reacts to scroll is showing up in everyday brand motion work, not just hero pieces.

design.title: Grainy, tactile textures return
design.summary: Flat, ultra-clean gradients are giving way to film grain, noise, and paper-like textures for a warmer, more analogue feel.

design.title: 3D and real-time render pipelines go mainstream
design.summary: Tools like Spline and real-time engines are making 3D motion accessible outside specialist studios, speeding up iteration on hero visuals.

design.title: Maximalist colour, minimalist layout
design.summary: Bold, saturated palettes paired with restrained grid systems, letting colour do the expressive work while structure stays disciplined.

design.title: Motion systems built for accessibility
design.summary: Designers are baking reduced-motion states and pacing controls into animation systems from the start, not as an afterthought.
